target.title: Fix Cursor pace detail when billing cycle quota is depleted
target.body:
## Summary
- Hide Cursor billing-cycle pace projection (deficit + run-out copy) once `remainingPercent` reaches zero.
- Align Cursor with `UsageStore.weeklyPace` and CLI behavior so depleted quotas no longer show a misleading "Runs out now" / "即将耗尽" label.
- Add an opt-in live QA test (`CODEXBAR_LIVE_CURSOR_PACE=1`) that rebuilds the menu card from a live Cursor fetch.

## Test plan
- [x] `swift test --filter CursorMenuCardModelTests`
- [x] `swiftlint --strict` on changed files
- [x] Live CLI: `CodexBarCLI usage --provider cursor` shows `0% left` for Total/Auto/API with no pace/run-out lines
- [x] Live menu model: `CODEXBAR_LIVE_CURSOR_PACE=1 swift test --filter "live cursor menu hides billing cycle pace when quota is depleted"` (passed against live account at 0% remaining)
- [ ] Optional reviewer UI spot-check: open Cursor menu card at 0% remaining and confirm pace detail is hidden (Peekaboo/screenshot; not required when live test passes)
